spans.s:
(इ) हिडि r. 1st cl. (हिण्डते)
1 To go, to move.
2 To disregard or disrespect.

m. (-म्बः)
A prince of the Rākṣasas slain by BHĪMA.
f. (-म्बा)
The sister of Hiḍimbā carried off by BHĪMA: these names are also read हिडम्ब, हिडम्बा.

m. (-जित्)
BHĪMA, the second of the Pāṇḍus.
E.
हिडिम्ब a Rākṣasa, and जित् conqueror; also similar compounds, as हिडिम्बनिसूदनः, हिडिम्बभिद्.

m. (-भित् or भिद्)
BHĪMA; see the last.

BHĪMA.
E.
हिडिम्बा a female Rākṣasa, and पति husband.

m. (-णः)
1 HANUMĀN, the monkey friend and ally of

BHĪMA.
E.
हिडिम्बा a female Rākṣasa, and रमण husband.
